title_en: The Recorded Sayings of Master Zhaozhou
author_zh: 趙州從諗 禪師 說

dialogues.title_en: The Cypress Tree in the Courtyard

dialogue.speaker: Monk / 僧
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「如何是祖師西來意？」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Rúhé shì zǔshī xī lái yì?'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'What is the intention of the ancestral teacher coming from the west?'

heine.text: A monk asked, 'What is the meaning of the Patriarch coming from the west?'

sasaki.text: A monk asked: 'What is the meaning of Bodhidharma's coming from the West?'

ai_literal.text: A monk asked: 'What is the ancestral teacher's coming-from-the-west meaning?'

hoffman.text: A monk asked, "What does it mean, 'Our founder came from the west'?"

source.work: Radical Zen: The Sayings of Jōshū, tr. Yoel Hoffman
source.verification: verbatim vs Terebess PDF reproduction of the Autumn Press text, 2026-08-08; Hoffman renders 柏樹子 as 'oak tree in the front yard'

dialogue.speaker: Zhaozhou / 趙州
dialogue.pinyin: Shī yuē: 'Tíng qián bǎi shù zǐ.'

cleary.text: The Master said, 'The cypress tree in the courtyard.'

heine.text: The Master said, 'The cypress tree in front of the hall.'

sasaki.text: The Master said: 'The oak tree in the front garden.'

ai_literal.text: The Master said: 'The courtyard-front cypress tree.'

hoffman.text: Jōshū said, "The oak tree in the front yard."

source.work: Radical Zen: The Sayings of Jōshū, tr. Yoel Hoffman
source.verification: verbatim vs Terebess PDF reproduction of the Autumn Press text, 2026-08-08; Hoffman renders 柏樹子 as 'oak tree in the front yard'

dialogue.speaker: Monk / 僧
dialogue.zh: 僧云：「和尚莫將境示人。」師曰：「我不將境示人。」僧云：「如何是祖師西來意？」師曰：「庭前柏樹子。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng yún: 'Héshang mò jiāng jìng shì rén.' Shī yuē: 'Wǒ bù jiāng jìng shì rén.' Sēng yún: 'Rúhé shì zǔshī xī lái yì?' Shī yuē: 'Tíng qián bǎi shù zǐ.'

cleary.text: The monk said, 'Master, do not point to objective circumstances to instruct people.' The Master said, 'I am not pointing to objective circumstances.' The monk said, 'What is the intention of the ancestral teacher coming from the west?' The Master said, 'The cypress tree in the courtyard.'

heine.text: The monk said, 'Master, do not use external objects to show people.' The Master said, 'I am not using external objects.' The monk repeated, 'What is the Patriarch's meaning?' The Master replied: 'The cypress tree in the garden.'

ai_literal.text: Monk said: 'Master, do not take the objective environment to show people.' Master said: 'I do not take the environment to show people.' Monk said: 'What is the Patriarch's meaning?' Master said: 'The courtyard-front cypress tree.'

hoffman.text: The monk said, "Please do not show the people the object." Jōshū said, "I will not." The monk repeated his question: "What does it mean, 'Our founder came from the west'?" Jōshū said, "The oak tree in the front yard."

source.work: Radical Zen: The Sayings of Jōshū, tr. Yoel Hoffman
source.verification: verbatim vs Terebess PDF reproduction of the Autumn Press text, 2026-08-08; Hoffman renders 柏樹子 as 'oak tree in the front yard'

dialogue.speaker: Monk / 僧
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「學人乍入叢林，乞師指示。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Xuérén zhà rù cónglín, qǐ shī zhǐshì.'

cleary.text: A monk said, 'I have just newly entered the monastery; please give me instructions.'

sasaki.text: A monk said to Jōshū: 'I have just entered the monastery. Please Master, instruct me.'

suzuki.text: A newly arrived monk asked Chao-chou: 'I am a new beginner; please show me the Way.'

ai_literal.text: Monk asked: 'This student has just entered the monastic grove; I beg the master for instruction.'

hoffman.text: A novice once said to the master, "I am only newly admitted into this monastery, and I beseech Your Reverence to teach and guide me."

source.work: Radical Zen: The Sayings of Jōshū, tr. Yoel Hoffman
source.verification: verbatim vs Terebess reproduction of Hoffman's text, 2026-08-08
source.reference: T1987 / Wash Your Bowl, dialogue unit 1 (translation book episode/page pending)

dialogue.speaker: Zhaozhou / 趙州
dialogue.zh: 師曰：「喫粥了也未？」僧曰：「喫粥了也。」師曰：「洗缽盂去。」其僧因此大悟。
dialogue.pinyin: Shī yuē: 'Chī zhōu le yě wèi?' Sēng yuē: 'Chī zhōu le yě.' Shī yuē: 'Xǐ bōyú qù.' Qí sēng yīn cǐ dà wù.

cleary.text: The Master said, 'Have you eaten your rice gruel yet?' The monk said, 'I have eaten it.' The Master said, 'Go wash your bowl.' At this the monk had a great realization.

sasaki.text: Jōshū said: 'Have you eaten your breakfast porridge?' The monk replied: 'I have.' Jōshū said: 'Then wash your bowls.' At these words the monk attained great awakening.

suzuki.text: Chao-chou asked: 'Have you had your breakfast?' 'Yes, Master, I have.' 'Then wash your bowls!' That monk was enlightened.

ai_literal.text: Master said: 'Have you eaten porridge or not yet?' Monk said: 'I have eaten porridge.' Master said: 'Go wash your alms bowl.' That monk because of this had great awakening.

hoffman.text: The master asked, "Have you taken your breakfast?" "Yes, master, I have." "Go wash your bowl," said the master. At these words, the novice experienced an instantaneous enlightenment.

source.work: Radical Zen: The Sayings of Jōshū, tr. Yoel Hoffman
source.verification: verbatim vs Terebess reproduction of Hoffman's text, 2026-08-08
source.reference: T1987 / Wash Your Bowl, dialogue unit 2 (translation book episode/page pending)

dialogue.speaker: Monk / 僧
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「久嚮趙州石橋，到來只見略彴子。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Jiǔ xiàng Zhàozhōu shíqiáo, dào lái zhǐ jiàn lüèzhuózi.'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'For a long time I have heard of the stone bridge of Zhaozhou, but having arrived here, I only see a simple plank bridge.'

sasaki.text: A monk asked: 'For long I have heard of the famous Stone Bridge of Jōshū, but coming here I see only a simple stepping-stone plank.'

ai_literal.text: Monk asked: 'For long I admired the Zhaozhou stone bridge, but upon arriving I only see a narrow log plank.'

dialogue.speaker: Zhaozhou / 趙州
dialogue.zh: 師曰：「汝只見略彴子，不見石橋。」僧曰：「如何是石橋？」師曰：「度驢度馬。」
dialogue.pinyin: Shī yuē: 'Rǔ zhǐ jiàn lüèzhuózi, bù jiàn shíqiáo.' Sēng yuē: 'Rúhé shì shíqiáo?' Shī yuē: 'Dù lǘ dù mǎ.'

cleary.text: The Master said, 'You only see the plank bridge; you do not see the stone bridge.' The monk asked, 'What is the stone bridge?' The Master said, 'It ferries donkeys, it ferries horses.'

sasaki.text: Jōshū said: 'You only see the simple plank, you don't see the stone bridge.' The monk said: 'What is the stone bridge?' Jōshū said: 'It lets donkeys cross, it lets horses cross.'

ai_literal.text: Master said: 'You only see the simple plank, not seeing the stone bridge.' Monk said: 'What is the stone bridge?' Master said: 'Carries donkeys, carries horses.'

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「大死底人卻活時如何？」師云：「不許夜行，投明須到。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Dà sǐ dǐ rén què huó shí rúhé?' Shī yún: 'Bù xǔ yè xíng, tóu míng xū dào.'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'When a person of the Great Death comes back to life, what then?' The Master said, 'I do not allow traveling by night; you must arrive by daylight.'

red_pine.text: A monk asked, 'When one who has thoroughly died returns to life, what is that like?' Zhaozhou replied, 'Night travel is forbidden; you must arrive in broad daylight.'

blyth.text: A monk asked, 'When one who has thoroughly died returns to life, what is that like?' Zhaozhou replied, 'Night travel is forbidden; you must arrive in broad daylight.'

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「如何是趙州？」師云：「東門、西門、南門、北門。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Rúhé shì Zhàozhōu?' Shī yún: 'Dōng mén, xī mén, nán mén, běi mén.'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'What is Zhaozhou?' The Master said, 'East gate, West gate, South gate, North gate.'

red_pine.text: A monk asked, 'What is Zhaozhou?' Zhaozhou replied, 'East gate, west gate, south gate, north gate.'

blyth.text: A monk asked, 'What is Zhaozhou?' Zhaozhou replied, 'East gate, west gate, south gate, north gate.'

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 嚴陽尊者問：「一物不將來時如何？」師云：「放下著。」尊者云：「既是一物不將來，放下箇甚麼？」師云：「放不下，擔取去。」
dialogue.pinyin: Yányáng zūnzhě wèn: 'Yī wù bù jiāng lái shí rúhé?' Shī yún: 'Fàng xià zhuó.' Zūnzhě yún: 'Jì shì yī wù bù jiāng lái, fàng xià gè shénme?' Shī yún: 'Fàng bù xià, dān qǔ qù.'

cleary.text: Venerable Yanyang asked, 'When I bring nothing at all with me, what then?' The Master said, 'Put it down.' Yanyang said, 'Since I bring nothing at all with me, what should I put down?' The Master said, 'If you cannot put it down, pick it up and carry it away.'

red_pine.text: Venerable Yanyang asked, 'What if I come carrying nothing at all?' Zhaozhou said, 'Drop it.' 'If I carry nothing, what can I drop?' asked Yanyang. 'If you can't drop it, carry it off,' said Zhaozhou.

blyth.text: Venerable Yanyang asked, 'What if I come carrying nothing at all?' Zhaozhou said, 'Drop it.' 'If I carry nothing, what can I drop?' asked Yanyang. 'If you can't drop it, carry it off,' said Zhaozhou.

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「如何是佛？」師云：「殿裏底。」僧云：「殿裏底是泥塑木彫。」師云：「是。」僧云：「如何是佛？」師云：「殿裏底。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Rúhé shì Fó?' Shī yún: 'Diàn lǐ dǐ.' Sēng yún: 'Diàn lǐ dǐ shì ní sù mù diāo.' Shī yún: 'Shì.' Sēng yún: 'Rúhé shì Fó?' Shī yún: 'Diàn lǐ dǐ.'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'What is Buddha?' The Master said, 'The one in the main hall.' The monk said, 'The one in the main hall is made of clay and wood.' The Master said, 'Yes, it is.' The monk asked, 'What is Buddha?' The Master said, 'The one in the main hall.'

red_pine.text: A monk asked Zhaozhou, 'Who is Buddha?' Zhaozhou said, 'The one sitting in the shrine.' 'That is a statue of mud and wood,' said the monk. 'Yes it is,' replied Zhaozhou. 'Who is Buddha?' asked the monk. 'The one sitting in the shrine,' replied Zhaozhou.

blyth.text: A monk asked Zhaozhou, 'Who is Buddha?' Zhaozhou said, 'The one sitting in the shrine.' 'That is a statue of mud and wood,' said the monk. 'Yes it is,' replied Zhaozhou. 'Who is Buddha?' asked the monk. 'The one sitting in the shrine,' replied Zhaozhou.

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「狗子還有佛性也無？」師云：「無。」僧云：「上至諸佛，下至螻蟻，皆有佛性；狗子為什麼卻無？」師云：「為伊有業識在。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Gǒuzǐ hái yǒu fóxìng yě wú?' Shī yún: 'Wú.' Sēng yún: 'Shàng zhì zhū fó, xià zhì lóuyǐ, jiē yǒu fóxìng; gǒuzǐ wèishénme què wú?' Shī yún: 'Wèi yī yǒu yèshí zài.'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'Does a dog have Buddha-nature or not?' The Master said, 'No (Wu).' The monk said, 'From all the Buddhas above down to crawling insects, all have Buddha-nature; why does a dog not have it?' The Master said, 'Because it still has karmic consciousness.'

red_pine.text: A monk asked Zhaozhou, 'Does a dog have Buddha-nature?' 'No,' said Zhaozhou. 'All beings from Buddhas down to ants have Buddha-nature; why doesn't a dog?' asked the monk. 'Because it is trapped in karmic consciousness,' replied Zhaozhou.

blyth.text: A monk asked Zhaozhou, 'Does a dog have Buddha-nature?' 'No,' said Zhaozhou. 'All beings from Buddhas down to ants have Buddha-nature; why doesn't a dog?' asked the monk. 'Because it is trapped in karmic consciousness,' replied Zhaozhou.

dialogues.title_en: The Great Way is Not Hard
dialogues.speaker: Zhaozhou / 趙州

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 師上堂云：「『至道無難，唯嫌揀擇。』纔有語言，是揀擇、是明白。老僧不在明白裏，是汝還護惜也無？」時有僧問：「既不在明白裏，護惜箇甚麼？」師云：「我亦不知。」
dialogue.pinyin: Shī shàngtáng yún: ''Zhì dào wú nán, wéi xián jiǎnzé.' ... Shī yún: 'Wǒ yì bù zhī.'

cleary.text: The Master ascended the seat and said, "'The Great Way is not difficult, it only avoids picking and choosing.' As soon as words are spoken, there is picking and choosing, there is clarity. This old monk does not abide in clarity; do you still cherish it or not?" A monk asked, "Since you do not abide in clarity, what is there to cherish?" The Master said, "I don't know either."

red_pine.text: Quoting the Xinxin Ming that the Way is not hard save for picking and choosing, Zhaozhou said he did not abide in clarity and asked what was left to cherish.

hoffman.text: Quoting the Xinxin Ming that the Way is not hard save for picking and choosing, Zhaozhou said he did not abide in clarity and asked what was left to cherish.

dialogues.title_pinyin: Ní Fó Mù Fó Jīn Fó
dialogues.title_en: Clay Buddha, Wood Buddha, Metal Buddha
dialogues.speaker: Zhaozhou / 趙州

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 師示眾云：「泥佛不度水，金佛不度爐，木佛不度火；真佛內裏坐。」
dialogue.pinyin: Shī shì zhòng yún: 'Ní fó bù dù shuǐ, jīn fó bù dù lú, mù fó bù dù huǒ; zhēn fó nèilǐ zuò.'

cleary.text: The Master addressed the assembly: 'A clay Buddha cannot cross water; a metal Buddha cannot cross a furnace; a wood Buddha cannot cross fire. The True Buddha sits inside.'

red_pine.text: Zhaozhou taught that clay, metal, and wood Buddhas perish in water, furnace, and fire; only the true inner Buddha endures.

hoffman.text: Zhaozhou taught that clay, metal, and wood Buddhas perish in water, furnace, and fire; only the true inner Buddha endures.

dialogues.title_en: A Good Thing is Not as Good as Nothing
dialogues.speaker: Zhaozhou / 趙州

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「如何是祖師西來意？」師云：「庭前柏樹子。」僧云：「不會。」師云：「好事不如無。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Rúhé shì zǔshī xī lái yì?' ... Shī yún: 'Hǎo shì bù rú wú.'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'What is the meaning of the Patriarch coming from the West?' The Master said, 'The cypress tree in the courtyard.' The monk said, 'I don't understand.' The Master said, 'A good thing is not as good as nothing at all.'

red_pine.text: When a monk failed to grasp the cypress tree in the courtyard, Zhaozhou said that even a good thing is not as good as nothing.

hoffman.text: When a monk failed to grasp the cypress tree in the courtyard, Zhaozhou said that even a good thing is not as good as nothing.

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「初生嬰兒，還有六識也無？」師云：「急水上打毬子。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Chū shēng yīng'ér, hái yǒu liù shì yě wú?' Shī yún: 'Jí shuǐ shàng dǎ qiú zǐ.'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'Does a newborn baby have the six senses or not?' The Master said, 'Like throwing a ball onto a rushing torrent.'

red_pine.text: Asked if a newborn baby possesses the six sense consciousnesses, Zhaozhou compared it to tossing a ball onto rapids.

hoffman.text: Asked if a newborn baby possesses the six sense consciousnesses, Zhaozhou compared it to tossing a ball onto rapids.

dialogues.title_en: The Bright Moon in the Blue Sky
dialogues.speaker: Zhaozhou / 趙州

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「如何是道？」師云：「牆外底。」僧云：「不問這箇道。」師云：「你問箇甚麼道？」僧云：「大道。」師云：「大道透長安。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Rúhé shì dào?' Shī yún: 'Qiáng wài dǐ.' Sēng yún: 'Bù wèn zhè gè dào.' Shī yún: 'Nǐ wèn gè shénme dào?' Sēng yún: 'Dà dào.' Shī yún: 'Dà dào tòu Cháng'ān.'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'What is the Way?' The Master said, 'The road outside the garden wall.' The monk said, 'I am not asking about that road.' The Master asked, 'What Way are you asking about?' The monk said, 'The Great Way.' The Master said, 'The Great Way leads straight to the capital Chang'an.'

red_pine.text: When a monk rejected Zhaozhou's road outside the garden wall to ask for the Great Way of Buddhism, Zhaozhou replied that the Great Way leads straight to the capital.

hoffman.text: When a monk rejected Zhaozhou's road outside the garden wall to ask for the Great Way of Buddhism, Zhaozhou replied that the Great Way leads straight to the capital.

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「某甲乍入叢林，乞師指示。」師云：「喫粥了也未？」僧云：「喫粥了也。」師云：「洗缽盂去。」其僧忽然有省。
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Mǒu jiǎ zhà rù cónglín, qǐ shī zhǐshì.' Shī yún: 'Chī zhōu le yě wèi?' Sēng yún: 'Chī zhōu le yě.' Shī yún: 'Xǐ bōyú qù.' Qí sēng hūrán yǒu shěng.

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'I have just entered the monastery; please give me instruction, Master.' The Master said, 'Have you eaten your porridge?' The monk said, 'I have eaten my porridge.' The Master said, 'Go wash your bowl.' At that moment the monk had an awakening.

red_pine.text: Told to go wash his bowl after finishing his morning porridge, a newly arrived monk suddenly awoke.

hoffman.text: Told to go wash his bowl after finishing his morning porridge, a newly arrived monk suddenly awoke.

dialogue.speaker: Monk & Zhaozhou / 問答
dialogue.zh: 僧問：「如何是趙州關？」師云：「石橋是。」
dialogue.pinyin: Sēng wèn: 'Rúhé shì Zhàozhōu guān?' Shī yún: 'Shí qiáo shì.'

cleary.text: A monk asked, 'What is the Barrier Gate of Zhaozhou?' The Master said, 'The Stone Bridge.'

red_pine.text: Asked for the Barrier of Zhaozhou, Zhaozhou pointed to his Stone Bridge.

hoffman.text: Asked for the Barrier of Zhaozhou, Zhaozhou pointed to his Stone Bridge.
